text: だけど　そだて　すぎなきゃ　そういう　しんぱいは　むようよ！

structure.jp: そだて　すぎなきゃ
そういう　しんぱいは　むようよ！
structure.en: that kind of worry is needless!

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.span: そだて　すぎなきゃ
patterns.explanation: すぎる added to a verb means doing it too much. そだて　すぎる = 'to raise them too much'.

patterns.name: 〜なければ
patterns.explanation: なければ means 'if you don't'; なきゃ is its short spoken form. そだて　すぎなきゃ = 'if you don't overtrain them'.
